summary: Full backend + frontend testing of FieldCollector MVP. 24/24 pytest backend tests PASS. UI flows for both ADMIN (dashboard, klien, akun, surat tugas, laporan, petugas list) and PETUGAS (login, home/Beranda summary, Tugas Saya list, Detail Tugas with Buka Maps) verified via Playwright. End-to-end business flow (admin creates penugasan -> ST nomor ST/FC/YYYY/MM/NNNN -> account becomes DITUGASKAN -> petugas submits laporan with photo -> admin sees laporan + photo auth via ?auth=token) validated via API. Authorization boundaries all enforced (petugas cannot hit admin endpoints and vice versa; petugas cannot report on account not in their letter).

minor.issue: `laporan_hari_ini` compares ISO datetime strings with a date-only prefix via $gte. Works for today but has no upper bound; counts anything created on today-or-later. Suggest using $gte today AND $lt tomorrow (same pattern already used in /dashboard/reports-7days).
Date filter uses `$lt: tanggal + 'T99'` which is a hacky string compare; works but fragile. Prefer $lt next-day ISO.

login_attempts also increments on first failure and sets locked_until 15 min ahead immediately; threshold check (>=5) is correct but any 5 failed attempts from same IP+email result in 429. Consider resetting locked_until only when count reaches threshold.
Token validated via jwt.decode but user existence/role not re-checked. Expired/invalid handled, but a user who was deactivated could still read files until token expiry (7 days). Low risk.

issues: Chart x-axis labels show 30/09..06/10 which may overlap with sidebar on narrow desktop widths; acceptable at 1920px.

action_items: (Optional) Tighten dashboard_stats `laporan_hari_ini` to use [today, tomorrow) range for consistency.
(Optional) Replace 'T99' date hack in list_laporan with proper next-day boundary.
(Optional) In serve_file, consider also validating user is active, not just token signature.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 900 lines in a single file; recommend splitting by domain (auth, admin, petugas, files) for maintainability.

Mixing `status` (business status per report: UNIT_DITEMUKAN/...) with `report_status` (SUBMITTED/REVIEWED) in field_reports — name collision risk; filter param `status` in GET /api/laporan filters business status which is correct but could be documented.
File serving accepts ?auth=token in query string — may be logged by proxies. Acceptable trade-off for ; worth noting in security review.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@demo.com/admin123, Petugas: petugas@demo.com/petugas123 (as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
seed_data_creation: Tests created a few TEST_ prefixed clients/SK/akun and one Surat Tugas (ST/FC/2026/10/0001) + 1 field report assigned to Andi Pratama via public API. Seed from backend/seed.py already provides SK/FIN/2026/0101 with 6+ accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are all green. Seed consumes one of the BELUM_DITUGASKAN akun per test run (the first one gets assigned, submitted, and ends in UNIT_DITEMUKAN state). If re-running tests, there must still be >=1 BELUM_DITUGASKAN account; otherwise seed_all needs to re-seed or add new accounts. The pytest for file serving reuses the admin token; both Bearer header and ?auth=token query are supported.
